name: Rock Climbing Adventure Training Course
benefit: - **Training:** A 6-day rock climbing adventure course for 100 children aged 9 to 12 years, conducted at Mount Abu or Junagadh Center.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be between 9 and 12 years. - The applicant must be physically fit.
